title: kaizen feature manifest (v2 — schema-driven CLI lens)
description: Declares a feature's subcommands and their input/output JSON-Schema contracts. Loaded by lens.py::Manifest.load. Subcommand schema paths are resolved RELATIVE TO THIS MANIFEST FILE.

version.description: Manifest schema version. v1 was the legacy descriptive yaml; v2 adds the subcommand→schema mapping. Bump on breaking shape changes.

feature.description: Kebab-case feature name. Matches the skills/<feature>/ directory name.

description.description: Optional one-line summary of what this feature surfaces.

paths.description: Documentation-only path manifest. Feature code reads paths via env vars + _paths.py; this section is for human readers + downstream tooling discovering where the feature stores data.

status.description: Documentation-only enum of valid work-status values. Code holds the authoritative tuple.

outcome.description: Documentation-only enum of valid outcome values.

metadata.description: Freeform per-feature metadata that isn't part of the contract.

input_schema.description: Path (relative to manifest file) to the JSON Schema validating subcommand input. Omit when the subcommand accepts no structured input.

output_schema.description: Path (relative to manifest file) to the JSON Schema validating the subcommand's envelope.data payload. Omit to opt out of output validation.

handler.description: Optional dotted-path to a Python callable that runs the subcommand. lens_dispatch resolves this when set; otherwise the CLI script wires the handler explicitly.
